description.name: Entry
description.text: Ten single attacks (0.71 each), grants [Attach Earth], [True Strike] and [Special Bonus] to the user

description.name: Attach Earth
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Earth damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Earth resistance +20%

description.name: True Strike
description.text: Grants [Physical High Quick Cast 1] to all allies in the front row after using an Earth ability

description.name: Special Bonus
description.text: Grants [Buff Earth 10% (15s)] to all allies after using three Earth abilities
